blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Burnaby total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Sperling-Duthie fell from 31 in June to 24 in October (−22.6%), and 14 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 5.6% of Burnaby’s 430 houses listed.

Sperling Avenue is the spine: it runs from Lougheed Highway and the SkyTrain station at its north end down to Deer Lake Park at its south end.
Buckingham Heights, the slope east of Deer Lake, sits within and beside the sub-area's south-east side, and Burnaby Lake Regional Park lies immediately north of Lougheed Highway.
The stock is almost entirely detached houses: post-war bungalows on the west side, and large custom and estate homes in the Buckingham Heights pocket on the slope east of Deer Lake.

Detached lots here fall under the City's R1 small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) district, so a house lot can be redeveloped as up to 3 to 6 dwelling units depending on lot area and proximity to a frequent transit network bus stop.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Burnaby's new Zoning Bylaw 2026 was adopted June 9, 2026 and took effect July 1, 2026, replacing the former Zoning Bylaw 1965, and the R1 SSMUH district dates to the June 2024 rezoning of all R district lots.
Burnaby 2050, the City's official community plan, was adopted December 9, 2025 and sets the land-use direction for the whole city including this area.
Woodward House, at 5195 Sperling Avenue and built in 1912, is on the City's heritage register, so heritage rules can touch a purchase on that street.
Burnaby is inside the speculation and vacancy tax taxable area, so residential owners here must declare each year.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Burnaby City Hall, at 4949 Canada Way, sits just west of the sub-area at Deer Lake, so civic business is inside the neighbourhood's orbit.
The Bill Copeland Sports Centre, at 3676 Kensington Avenue, is the area's arena, with a National Hockey League-size rink seating 1,984.
The 1912 Woodward House at 5195 Sperling Avenue is the heritage-register anchor on the spine itself, not a museum elsewhere in the city.

Burnaby's 2026 residential tax rate is 3.28373 per 1,000 dollars of assessed value, and the average residential assessment in Burnaby decreased by 5.29 percent in 2026, which does not necessarily mean an individual bill falls, because taxes depend on the change in a property's assessment relative to the class average.
Property taxes were due July 3, 2026, with a 5 percent penalty after the July due date and a further 5 percent after the September due date.
Assessment notices arrive from BC Assessment each January, and the assessed value on the notice is the value the mill rate is applied to.
Sperling–Burnaby Lake Station, on the Millennium Line, stands at Sperling Avenue and Lougheed Highway at the area's north end, and Sperling Avenue runs south from it to Deer Lake Park.
Canada Way crosses the area and Burnaby City Hall sits on it at 4949 Canada Way, just west of the sub-area.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Confirm the lot's R1 SSMUH eligibility and unit count with the City before assuming a multiplex, because the count turns on lot area and on distance to a frequent transit network bus stop.
Check the heritage register before buying on Sperling Avenue itself, since Woodward House at 5195 Sperling Avenue is a registered heritage property.

blocks.text: Sperling-Duthie home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

20 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie with a median price of $1,850,250 (the middle half sold between $1,673,750 and $2,013,750), taking a median of 35 days to sell at 94.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $615 per square foot, a median year built of 1974 and a median lot of 7,431 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 24 houses listed in Sperling-Duthie. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sperling-Duthie a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Sperling-Duthie had a sales ratio of 17%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Sperling-Duthie from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie over those 5 months, out of 251 in all of Burnaby.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: Which schools serve Sperling Avenue addresses?
faq.a: École Sperling Elementary, at 2200 Sperling Avenue, is the School District No.

faq.q: Is the Deer Lake boardwalk open?
faq.a: Not the boat-launch section: the boardwalk section by the boat launch in Deer Lake Park has been closed from September 21, 2026 for full replacement, with completion scheduled for winter 2027 and a detour via Sperling Avenue and Deer Lake Drive.

faq.q: Can I build a multiplex on a Sperling-Duthie house lot?
faq.a: Possibly, under the R1 SSMUH district: newly rezoned R1 lots are eligible for up to 3 to 6 dwelling units depending on lot area and proximity to a frequent transit network bus stop, and the count is inclusive of any secondary suites.

faq.q: What is happening at Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: Burnaby Hospital, at 3935 Kincaid Street, is being redeveloped in phases: Phase 1 is a six-storey 83-bed pavilion, and Phase 2 is a 160-bed acute care tower with a cancer centre, with Phase 2 dates still to be determined.

faq.q: What did houses in Sperling-Duthie sell for?
faq.a: 20 houses sold in Sperling-Duthie between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,850,250.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Sperling-Duthie?
faq.a: The median was 35 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.5% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
